# Fixture layout

Each fixture directory contains the following files:

- `in.jsx` – the source module under test.
- `out.js` – the expected JavaScript produced by the native SWC transformer with `extract: false`.
- `actual.js` – the latest transformer output. Update this (and `out.js`) by running:

  ```sh
  cargo test --manifest-path packages/babel-plugin-swc/Cargo.toml --test fixtures -- --overwrite
  ```

- `babel-out.js` – reference output generated by the Babel plugin pipeline.
- `babel-style-rules.json` – style rules emitted by the Babel extract pass.
- `swc-style-rules.json` – style rules emitted by the SWC transformer when `extract: true`. Update this file using the command above or by setting `SWC_FIXTURES_OVERWRITE=1` before executing the fixtures test.
